rows.text: Article 1 of the Council's declaration gives the results of the first round, 'auquel il a été procédé les 9 et 10 avril 2022', for twelve candidates; paragraph 20 finds that no candidate obtained the absolute majority of votes cast.

The Council declared the first-round results on 13 April 2022 ('Rendu public le 13 avril 2022'); Article 2 says the proclamation of the results of the whole election will follow under the decree of 8 March 2001; the reference line gives 'JORF n°0088 du 14 avril 2022, texte n° 1'.

locator.item: Articles 2 and 3; closing formula and reference line
